method.parser: one-off Python standard-library JSON traversal; no dependency added
method.retainer_path: shortest strong path from the heap root; weak edges excluded

cppgc_cell_observation.interpretation: unclassified single-snapshot observation; conservative stack roots and live engine objects prevent a leak conclusion

limits: This is one controlled document scene and only traces the tagged test probe.
The shortest path does not enumerate all retaining paths or explain all live DOM/native objects.

The snapshot contains 129 root-reachable RovesJsCell nodes; conservative C++ stack roots can preserve pointer-like stack values, so this count does not identify leaks or distinguish live owners from transient retention.
It is not a time-series measurement and does not establish absence of general retention or leaks.
